rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a mismatch or the feeling that something does not fit.

example.english: Putting an old television in the newly renovated cha chaan teng creates a sense of incongruity.
example.traditional: 新裝修嘅茶餐廳擺部舊電視，成件事有種違和感。
example.jyutping: san1 zong1 sau1 ge3 caa4 caan1 teng1 baai2 bou6 gau6 din6 si6 sing4 gin6 si6 jau5 zung2 wai4 wo4 gam2

rows.note: Use this for a specific point of disagreement between people, views, or positions.

example.english: There was an incongruity between our views on rent, and we talked all night without reaching a consensus.
example.traditional: 我哋對租金嘅睇法有分歧，傾咗成晚都未有共識。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 deoi3 zou1 gam1 ge3 tai2 faat3 jau5 fan1 kei4 king1 zo2 seng4 maan5 dou1 mei6 jau5 gung6 sik1

rows.note: Use this pattern to name an actual object that looks out of place in its surroundings.

example.english: Putting a neon light in a classical study is truly an incongruity of a decoration.
example.traditional: 喺古典書房入面擺部霓虹燈，真係唔啱位嘅裝飾。
example.jyutping: hai2 gu2 din2 syu1 fong2 jap6 min6 baai2 bou6 ngai4 hung4 dang1 zan1 hai6 m4 ngaam1 wai6 ge3 zong1 sik1
